title: ozothamnus occidentalis
intro: Ozothamnus occidentalis, commonly known as the coastal whitewood or white wood bush, is a shrub native to Australia. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ozothamnus occidentalis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential therapeutic applications of Ozothamnus occidentalis.
